lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Web(1) to side flange A(6), about 90 deg, large-radius real fold. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line sits on the outer-skin apex: nearest scan point is 0.01-0.05 mm away and the outermost point is 0.03-0.10 mm lateral. The line is parallel to the fold. It runs from the 3-way corner relief at the end wall (the fold surface leaves the line about 2-3 mm before the start) to the open-end material edge (it leaves 0.6 mm past the end). This covers about 97% of the visible fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web(1) to side flange B(5), about 90 deg, real fold. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer apex: nearest point 0.02-0.10 mm, outermost point 0.31-0.41 mm lateral on a large-radius arc, which is well under 1 mm. The line is parallel and spans the full length from the end-wall corner relief to the open end, about 97% of the visible fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Web(1) to end wall(8), about 90 deg, real fold. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer apex: nearest point 0.13-0.20 mm, outermost point 0.13-0.20 mm lateral. The line is parallel and spans between the two corner reliefs; the apex surface stays within 1 mm for only about 1.5-2 mm beyond each end. That is about 36 of about 39 mm, or 92% of the visible fold.
